title: "Reading SR Linux with gNMI"
---

# Reading SR Linux with gNMI

The CLI shows the same data the box will give a controller. This lab reads one interface over gNMI with the `gnmic` image already on the host, then changes the description and reads it again.

## Learning goals

By the end of this chapter you can:

- Find the SR Linux management address from `containerlab inspect`
- Get one YANG path with gnmic
- Change a leaf from the CLI and see the get change
- Keep the gNMI client off the data-plane links

## Topology

Use the LLDP lab, or a single SR Linux node with no links. A single node is enough.

```yaml
name: gnmi
topology:
  kinds:
    nokia_srlinux:
      image: ghcr.io/nokia/srlinux:latest
      memory: 2G
  nodes:
    srl:
      kind: nokia_srlinux
```

Set a description so the get has something to return:

```text
enter candidate
set interface ethernet-1/1 description lab-host-track
set interface ethernet-1/1 admin-state enable
commit now
```

## Get

```bash
containerlab inspect -t topology.clab.yml
```

Take the IPv4 address of `clab-gnmi-srl`. The management network Containerlab creates is reachable from a container on that network. `gnmic` is not installed on the host. Run the image:

```bash
docker run --rm --network clab ghcr.io/openconfig/gnmic:latest \
  --address <mgmt-ip>:57400 \
  --username admin \
  --password 'NokiaSrl1!' \
  --insecure \
  get --path /interface[name=ethernet-1/1]/description
```

The Docker network name is `clab` unless you set another management network. If the run cannot resolve the node, use the address from `inspect` rather than the container name.

### Predict

- The get returns `lab-host-track`.
- Change the description to `changed` and commit. The next get returns `changed`.
- A wrong password fails before any path is read. Fix the password. Do not open the port to anything but the lab.

## Drill

Subscribe for 30 seconds instead of get:

```bash
docker run --rm --network clab ghcr.io/openconfig/gnmic:latest \
  --address <mgmt-ip>:57400 \
  --username admin \
  --password 'NokiaSrl1!' \
  --insecure \
  subscribe --path /interface[name=ethernet-1/1]/admin-state \
  --mode once
```

`--mode once` is a single sample. If you have time, use stream mode, shut the interface from `sr_cli`, and watch the update. Cancel the client when you have seen it. Do not leave a subscribe running.
